shots.narration: [softly] 抬头看。对，就是我。我叫“希望”，想给你讲个故事。
shots.action: A blue whale glides slowly through the air above the crowd and turns her head toward the viewer.
shots.camera: Low angle from the floor, slow tilt up.
shots.location: A grand Romanesque museum hall with terracotta arches, daylight through high windows.

shots.narration: 很久以前，我是一头年幼的雌性蓝鲸，大海就是我的整个世界。
shots.action: The whale swims forward and does one slow barrel roll.
shots.camera: Tracking shot alongside her, gentle drift.
shots.location: Open deep blue ocean, cool rippling light from the surface far above.

shots.narration: [softly] 1891年3月25日的清晨，我搁浅在一片沙洲上。
shots.action: The whale drifts into shallow water and comes to rest on a pale sandbar as small waves wash around her.
shots.camera: Slow push in at water level.
shots.location: A shallow harbour mouth on the Irish coast at dawn, 1891, grey-pink sky.

shots.narration: 那里是爱尔兰的韦克斯福德港口，远离我熟悉的深海。
shots.action: The whale lies still on the sandbar while the tide slowly pulls back around her.
shots.camera: High wide aerial shot, slowly rising.
shots.location: The mouth of a wide harbour on the Irish coast at dawn, long sandbars, distant low shore.

shots.narration: 我的骨架重达四点五吨，被自然历史博物馆买下，只花了250英镑！
shots.action: The whale floats past and her body turns softly translucent, a glowing skeleton showing inside.
shots.location: A dim Victorian museum storeroom with wooden crates and warm gas lamps.

shots.narration: 从1934年起，我悬挂在哺乳动物展厅，静静地从高处望着人们。
shots.action: The whale hangs almost still high in the air while tiny visitors pass far below.
shots.camera: Static high angle looking down past her, light shifting from day to dusk.
shots.location: A long old museum gallery with a glass roof, 1930s.

shots.narration: 2017年7月，我搬进辛兹大厅，接替了1979年起在此的梁龙“迪皮”。
shots.action: The whale sweeps down into the hall in one long diving lunge as visitors look up.
shots.camera: Wide shot from a balcony, following her dive.
shots.location: A grand Romanesque museum hall with terracotta arches, bright daylight.

shots.narration: 我身长25.2米。这么大的身体，配得上一个大大的名字。
shots.action: The whale glides the full length of the hall, passing slowly over the camera from nose to tail.
shots.camera: Directly below, looking up as she passes overhead.
shots.location: A grand Romanesque museum hall with terracotta arches, daylight through high windows.

shots.narration: 人们叫我“希望”，象征人类有力量塑造可持续的未来。[whispers] 而这，要靠你们。
shots.action: The whale turns to face the viewer and glides gently closer.
shots.camera: Eye level, slow push in to her eye.
shots.location: A grand Romanesque museum hall, the light slowly turning to rippling ocean blue.
